compound.name: caffeic acid
compound.one_liner: The building block of rosmarinic acid; also one of its breakdown products in people.

occurrences.source_citation: EMA/HMPC. Assessment report on Melissa officinalis L., folium. EMA/HMPC/196746/2012 (14 May 2013). https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/herbal-report/final-assessment-report-melissa-officinalis-l-folium_en.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: EMA names caffeic acid among the hydroxycinnamic acid derivatives (no amount). | Basis as recorded: ppm as listed by Duke (basis not stated per row; for 'Essent. Oil' parts it is ppm of the oil, 10000 ppm = 1 %) Basis (fresh/dry weight) not stated by the source; excluded from /compare until confirmed.

compound.absorption_bioavailability: Caffeic acid appears in human urine after rosmarinic acid intake, as a degradation product [45].
compound.teaching_note: Caffeic acid links plant and person: the plant builds rosmarinic acid from it, and the body breaks rosmarinic acid back down to it [45].
gaps: Occurrence rests on Duke + an EMA mention without amount.
No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
